g.text: Schmitt buffers condition all open-drain monitor inputs. Source/power-off/propagation timing remains physical validation.

g.desc: Schmitt buffers condition all open-drain monitor inputs. Source/power-off/propagation timing remains physical validation.

g.text: FAULT SR latch holds all converter/load enables off after switch fault; raw-AON remains powered until external cycle.

g.desc: FAULT SR latch holds all converter/load enables off after switch fault; raw-AON remains powered until external cycle.

g.text: CAP SR latch arms only with qualified USB and cap-start. Loaded-cap UVLO or proven backup loss disarms; cap rebound cannot rearm.

g.desc: CAP SR latch arms only with qualified USB and cap-start. Loaded-cap UVLO or proven backup loss disarms; cap rebound cannot rearm.

g.text: No status blanking. USB status senses RAW + LIMITED_5V, never the cap-fed common rail alone.

g.desc: No status blanking. USB status senses RAW + LIMITED_5V, never the cap-fed common rail alone.
